## What's changed

- Added persistent Continue Watching support for titles streamed from Discover in Tater Tube Player.
- Returned a stable, privacy-safe Discover playback identity so the player can resume the same title after an app or device restart without saving indexer credentials or a player-specific stream URL.
- Preserved the selected Discover stream, artwork, synopsis, and playback position in the resume row.
- Kept the new response fields additive and scoped to modern-player Discover playback so existing Tater Tube clients retain their current behavior.
